title: finding: liveness dashboard.json `widgets.actionUrl` closure claim ("Nothing anywhere read `widget.actionUrl`") no longer measures true — objectui's widget config panel reads and authors the widget-level key
body:
Observation-class finding from the axis-③ liveness audit (ledger claims vs measured objectui readers). Filed unassigned for triage; **ledger verdict vs measured reader disagree — this card does not prescribe which side is right** (re-verdict/note refresh OR objectui config-panel cleanup is triage's fork).

## Audited revisions (E24)

- objectstack `origin/main` @ `4ac12ef4cfe4a1925fb7e950c56d7aff0bbc5381`
- objectui `origin/main` @ `5bfaabde05c3876c9604a2aa47f4822f9e6de8b5`

Both read via `git fetch` + `git archive` of `origin/main`, not working trees.

## The ledger claim

`packages/spec/liveness/dashboard.json` → `props.widgets.children.actionUrl` (`status: "dead"`, `verifiedAt: "2026-08-04"`):

> "CALL GRAPH CLOSED BY HAND 2026-08-03, re-measured 2026-08-04 (objectui @91757a7). All 14 `actionUrl` occurrences in DashboardRenderer.tsx are scoped to `schema.header.actions[]` (…) — that is the DashboardHeaderAction schema, a different shape. **Nothing anywhere read `widget.actionUrl`.**"

Retired 2026-08-04 via #5010 / ADR-0049 D2 — `retiredKey` tombstone, "authoring it is now a tsc error and a parse error".

## Measured reality at objectui @5bfaabd

The DashboardRenderer half of the claim still holds (all its `actionUrl` reads are `header.actions[]`-scoped). But the closure "nothing anywhere" does not:

1. `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardWithConfig.tsx:114` — widget-level **read**, on the widget found in `liveSchema.widgets`:

```ts
      actionUrl: widget.actionUrl ?? '',
```

2. `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/WidgetConfigPanel.tsx:391` — the widget config editor **offers the key** as an authoring field (Behavior group):

```ts
          {
            key: 'actionUrl',
            label: 'Click-through URL',
            type: 'input',
            placeholder: 'https://...',
          },
```

3. `DashboardWithConfig.tsx` `handleWidgetFieldChange` writes edits back as `{ ...w, [field]: value }` into `liveSchema.widgets` — i.e. the panel **authors** `widget.actionUrl` into the live schema. (Whether the ADR-0021 save scrub drops it again on persist was NOT measured; the save comment claims "legacy keys scrubbed" for dataset-shape keys only.)

4. Corroborating type-side drift: `packages/types/src/complex.ts:675-677` (`DashboardWidgetSchema` docblock) still says "`actionUrl`, `actionType`, `actionIcon` … all flow in from the spec through the `extends` above" — flowing in from a spec where all three are tombstones.

## Why it matters

The tombstone's contract is "authoring it is a tsc error and a parse error" — yet the Studio widget panel presents a UI field that authors exactly this key. Either the ledger row's closure claim needs re-measuring/annotating, or the panel field is the dangling producer the 2026-08-04 sweep deleted on the renderer side but not on the config side. Not prescribing which.

## Dedup

- objectui#3901 is the known axis-③ specimen (form-view `spec.aria`) — different key, different file.
- Org-wide open-issue searches for `actionUrl`, `DashboardWithConfig`, `WidgetConfigPanel` return no card about the widget-level key. objectstack#5175 is `chartConfig`, adjacent but distinct.

## Suggested lane

Cross-lane: the ledger row is spec-surface; the measured reader is objectui `plugin-dashboard`. Likely wants a paired disposition rather than a single-repo fix.

Provenance: cross-repo read-only audit, session https://claude.ai/code/session_018ffcE95NaMJcL9XJ9VDYgk
